# iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority (Data Source)

This data source can read the Wireless AP Tag Source Priority configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `priorities` (Attributes List) Priority for tag source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--priorities))

<a id="nestedatt--priorities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `priorities`

Read-Only:

- `priority` (Number) Priority for tag source
- `source` (String) tag source
